recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up of a male musician looking down at an acoustic guitar, set against a heavily textured, mottled blue and grey background. The lighting is soft and directional, highlighting the contours of the face and the satin sheen of the shirt.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's downward gaze directs the eye to the guitar body
Warm wood tones of the guitar contrast with the cool blue background
Vertical typography on the left balances the horizontal neck of the guitar
Textured background provides depth without distracting from the subject
coreInvariants: Acoustic guitar as a central prop
Subject in a dark satin-finish button-down shirt

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, occupying the middle and right two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The acoustic guitar body in the lower left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, follows the gaze down to the guitar, then follows the guitar neck to the right-hand text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Concentrated in the upper left and lower right corners, filled with textured patterns.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy and mottled blue (background and shirt)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark clothing and the bright guitar/text; low saturation in the background to emphasize the subject.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid bright primary reds or greens
Limit to cool blues, warm browns, and metallic accents

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Tall, condensed serif with high stroke contrast
letterConstructionRules: Thin horizontal strokes compared to thick verticals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended descenders on specific capital letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Tall condensed display serif paired with a widely spaced, lighter weight serif for secondary info.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, condensed verticality of the primary text.
Provides the clean, classic serif look for the secondary text with wide tracking.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A man with styled hair and a mustache, wearing a dark blue satin shirt, looking down while playing a wooden acoustic guitar. The background is a textured, mottled wall with shades of blue, grey, and black. Soft studio lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, vertically stacked, condensed gold serif text in the upper left. Add smaller, widely spaced white serif text in the lower right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the guitar wood tone warm and rich?
Is the background texture visible but not distracting?
Is the primary text condensed and vertically dominant?
Is there a clear diagonal flow from top-left to bottom-right?

mustRedesign: Exact wording of the original text

mustAchieve: Balanced color temperature between cool background and warm subject

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the guitar neck does not obscure the secondary text.
Check that the satin shirt has realistic highlights.
Verify the gold text has a subtle metallic sheen.
Confirm the background texture looks like painted plaster or stone.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a moody, textured blue portrait of a musician with high-contrast, vertically-oriented condensed serif typography for a classic country-rock aesthetic.
